metadata.title: Acme Corp Cloud Platform Plan of Action and Milestones

observation.title: Remote Access Enhancement Not Implemented
observation.description: AC-17(1) remote access monitoring enhancement is not implemented in the system.

observation.title: Transmission Confidentiality Missing
observation.description: SC-8 protections for data in transit have not been fully implemented across all communication paths.

observation.title: Account Management Statement Coverage Gap
observation.description: AC-2 implementation is missing coverage for statement item (d) regarding conditions for group and role membership.

observation.title: Audit Event Type Parameter Not Configured
observation.description: AU-2 organization-defined audit event types parameter has not been configured in the SIEM platform.

observation.title: Cryptographic Protection Not Implemented
observation.description: SC-13 cryptographic protection mechanisms required by the baseline are not implemented.

risk.title: Remote Access Monitoring Gap
risk.description: Without AC-17(1), remote access connections may not be adequately monitored, increasing risk of unauthorized access.
risk.statement: Unmonitored remote access creates potential for unauthorized system access without detection.

risk.title: Data-in-Transit Exposure
risk.description: Without SC-8, sensitive data may be exposed during transmission between system components.
risk.statement: Lack of transmission confidentiality protection creates data exposure risk.

risk.title: Incomplete Account Management Controls
risk.description: Partial implementation of AC-2 leaves gaps in account management lifecycle coverage.
risk.statement: Incomplete account management implementation may result in orphaned accounts or unauthorized access.

risk.title: Audit Configuration Gap
risk.description: Missing audit event type configuration may cause missed security events during incident response.
risk.statement: Incomplete audit configuration may miss critical security events.

risk.title: Missing Cryptographic Protection
risk.description: SC-13 cryptographic protections are entirely missing from the system implementation.
risk.statement: Absence of required cryptographic protections exposes sensitive data to unauthorized access.

poam-item.title: Implement Remote Access Monitoring Enhancement
poam-item.description: Deploy remote access monitoring and control capabilities to satisfy AC-17(1) requirements.

poam-item.title: Implement Transmission Confidentiality Protection
poam-item.description: Deploy end-to-end encryption for all internal and external communication paths to satisfy SC-8.

poam-item.title: Complete Account Management Implementation
poam-item.description: Add missing statement coverage for AC-2 control implementation, specifically item (d).

poam-item.title: Configure SIEM Audit Event Types
poam-item.description: Configure organization-defined audit event types in SIEM platform per profile parameter requirements.

poam-item.title: Implement Cryptographic Protection Controls
poam-item.description: Implement required cryptographic protection mechanisms per SC-13 control requirements.
